subject: Acme trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@acme.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-call recap)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to align on evaluation goals. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Success criteria you mentioned: 3 successful workflows (multi-turn summarization + retrieval) and sustained peak of ~100k tokens/day.
- Trial timing: you want to run for two full weeks, then convert to paid if criteria met. You suggested a billing target start of ~July 1.
- Procurement path: Jordan said Acme prefers PO-based procurement but will confirm whether a credit card purchase is required for any initial pilots.
- Marketplace: you indicated marketplace procurement is a lower priority but might be considered if PO flow takes longer.

Action items
- Jordan/Sonia: confirm final procurement path (PO vs card) and share any internal PO template or vendor registration link by EOD 6/25.
- Marissa/Neha: share Redwood procurement questionnaire and PO template; confirm W-9 and billing contact. (Attached: Redwood_PO_Template.docx, procurement questionnaire)
- Marissa: will enable trial workspace, pre-load recommended prompt templates, and schedule a quick check-in mid-trial.

Attaching: Redwood procurement questionnaire and PO template to speed review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you ramped up.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: Redwood_PO_Template.docx (doc), Redwood_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: we do intend to purchase via PO for production. For the initial trial, Procurement is okay with a PO-based pilot as long as we have a short SOW and a vendor invoice. I will confirm if we need a card on file for any sandbox/marketplace purchases, but that's unlikely.
- Attachments: I filled out your procurement questionnaire and attached it here. Procurement prefers standard PO terms; I'll work with Sonia to share our PO template.
- Success criteria: confirmed — we need 3 successful workflows + sustained peak of ~100k tokens/day to trigger conversion conversations. If we hit those by the end of the trial, we expect to start billing on 2026-07-01.

Next steps: 
1) I'll share the PO template and procurement contact details by 6/25.
2) Sonia will follow up on vendor onboarding items.
3) We'll send a PO draft as soon as internal approvals are done (target 6/25-6/28).

Attaching: Acme_filled_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf

—
Jordan Reed
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
jordan.reed@acme.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Jordan — thanks for the filled questionnaire. Couple of notes from our side: 

- W-9 & invoice: I attached our W-9 and a sample invoice in case procurement needs it for the PO.
- DocuSign: if PO needs an executed Master Subscription Agreement we can send a DocuSign envelope; otherwise procurement can send the PO and we'll invoice against it.

Proposed timeline: 
- 6/25: receive PO draft from Acme procurement (per your note).
- 6/26: Redwood legal/rev ops review PO and prepare invoice.
- 7/01: target billing start if success criteria met during trial.

Looping in Rishi (cc) to flag potential small credit to cover initial trial overages if there are delays with a PO.
